title: review: fix round 1 (review): S1f env_policy: allowlisted environment propagation for worker subprocesses (off/shadow/ac
spec: Fix round 1 for T-1114: review T-1165 requested changes. fix round 1: address review T-1165 comment orchestrator/goals.py:119 [med]: _create_goal_task and launch_planner now call env_policy.worker_env() directly in-process, and worker_env calls bus.log_run() internally. bus.log_run() writes to RUNS = STATE/"runs"/<date>.jsonl where STATE = ROOT / ".orchestrator", and ROOT/STATE are module-level constants resolved once from this process's own ORCH_ROOT env var (orchestrator/__init__.py), not from the repo_path argument goals.py  fix round 1 rule: worker_env must never write to this process's STATE when called for another repository: add a keyword root=None; when root is given and differs from the orchestrator's own STATE root, append the env_policy runs row to <root>/.orchestrator/runs/<date>.jsonl directly (same row shape as bus.log_run, names only); goals._create_goal_task and launch_planner and planner_shadow.launch pass their repo_path as root; add a test that a foreign root receives the row and the home runs file does not. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until it exits 0; do not ask questions; report files changed and failures-only output.
acceptance: tests/test_env_policy.py::test_active_mode_allowlists_and_keeps_extra (a base env with secret-looking names is stripped, PATH and ORCH_* kept, extra keys kept)
tests/test_env_policy.py::test_shadow_mode_only_reports (env unchanged, stripped names listed, log row written with names only)
tests/test_env_policy.py::test_log_row_never_contains_values (a synthetic value never appears in the runs row)
tests/test_spawn.py::test_spawn_uses_env_policy (patched Popen receives the env from worker_env; oauth token passed as extra)
tests/test_env_policy.py::test_token_veto_and_exact_name_override (GIT_AUTHOR_NAME passes, SSH_AUTH_SOCK passes via exact entry, a name with the token TOKEN is stripped)
tests/test_env_policy.py::test_all_spawn_paths_use_worker_env (spawn, executor, goals, planner_shadow patched launches receive worker_env output)
